messages:
Zara: Heads-up — noticing gaps in permissions telemetry for the enterprise role rollout. RBAC changes landed last night but we can't correlate permission denials with route decisions. Anyone else seeing this?
Anya: yep. found a couple 403s in prod but no audit event. looks like scope-eval didn't emit event when fallback routing hit.
Sam: Is the console preview for effective-permissions enabled for canary tenants? customers say UI shows allowed but API denies.
Mike: That's a serious mismatch. We need console preview and server eval to match. Quick ask: can we add a 'simulated-eval' log stream for canary so we can diff outcomes without affecting traffic?
Zara: Proposal: emit two events per eval during canary: permission_eval(simulated) and permission_eval(actual). include tenant_id, route, model_id, decision, reason, eval_version. e.g.:
```json
{
  "event": "permission_eval",
  "tenant": "t_123",
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "decision": "deny",
  "reason": "scope-mismatch",
  "mode": "simulated"
}
```
Anya: Works for me. storage note: tag simulated with low-retention index or route to S3. don't bloat the main metrics index.
Sam: Console UX: show a small red/yellow badge on the tenant rollout page — 'telemetry mismatch'. Add link 'View sampled evals' that overlays simulated vs actual for quick diffs.
Mike: @Zara what's our rollout %? are we at 10%?
Zara: Currently 10% for Dedicated + Hosted enterprise tenants. rollback-on-deny flag is enabled for the canary.
deploy-bot: deploy: permissions-eval-1.4 -> prod (canary 10%) by Zara at 2026-03-20T14:02Z :rocket:
Anya: After the deploy I saw permission_eval latency spike — median from ~4ms to ~18ms on some paths. suspect sync logging causing extra I/O.
Zara: Good catch. Suggest make eval logging async: buffer -> kafka. Also add telemetry.sampling_rate override per-tenant so we can tune volume.
Sam: UX note: when sampling_rate > 0 show 'partial sampling' in audit UI and add docs explaining sampled data may not show all denials.
Mike: Ops ask: add metric permission_mismatch_rate = (#simulated != #actual) / total_samples. alert if >2% over 30m.
Anya: I'll add that to the console dashboards and wire alerting to eng-oncall Slack.
Zara: Plan: (1) implement simulated events with mode field + low-retention index, (2) make eval logs async, (3) add mismatch metric + dashboard, (4) small UX badge + sampled view. target: ship in next patch and monitor 48h. anyone object?
Sam: :thumbsup: no objections. I'll draft the UX copy for the badge and the sampled view.
Mike: I'll notify customer-success to give a heads-up to affected tenants.
Anya: I'll create a short oncall playbook for interpreting mismatch alerts (sampling noise vs real mismatch).
Zara: :raised_hands: Thanks — will send PR tonight and add the event schema to the repo.
